documentation.text: Onboarding and development plan cycle, one case per employee. The case file is the system of record for business content (the development plan, its history in PreviousRounds, equipment, the onboarding checklist); the devplan database holds only personal data (x-pii, see dv_employee_details.humantask) and shared, cross-case configuration (department, job title and checklist-template lookups). The case is continuous: it has no completion milestone.

Only for new joiners: starts when the devplan backend creates the Onboarding case file item right after "+ New Employee" started the case. Cases started for an existing employee never get that item, so this stage never starts for them. The IT request, checklist and issued assets live in the case file (Onboarding); only the employee's personal details stay in the devplan database.
Mail to HR (manager in cc) when the Onboarding stage ends (completes, or exits on the milestone Employee onboarded). At case level, because the stage itself has ended by then.
Continuous: runs for the life of the case.
Onboarding step 1. Owner: HR.
Onboarding step 2. Owner: HR. Send to IT starts the Equipment approval by IT.
Mail to the IT admin that an equipment request is waiting.
Owner: IT admin. Issue equipment and set up accounts.
HR, once every mandatory checklist item is done. The backend sets Onboarding.mandatoryItemsDone first.
Ends onboarding. Development plan, Appraisal and Work cycle are then started by hand.

cafienne:implementation.name: EmployeeDetails

documentation.text: Onboarding step 1 - Employee details. Owner: HR. The "Details" object is personal data: the devplan backend reads and writes it in its own database (x-pii "employee"), never in the case file. Its field list, titles, required-ness and layout come from the employee table's own columns and column comments (see migration V13__employee_details_schema_from_db.sql / forms/TableStore.java), not from this task-model - the case model only carries the "x-pii": "employee" routing marker. On complete the backend creates the account and returns the Employee case item.

cafienne:implementation.name: EquipmentRequestByHR

documentation.text: Onboarding step 2 - Equipment request by HR. Owner: HR. The request is ordinary case-file content, written straight to Onboarding.ITRequest; on complete the backend syncs the IT admin's checklist items and marks Onboarding.itRequestSent, which starts the IT admin's Equipment approval by IT.

cafienne:implementation.name: EquipmentApprovalByIT

documentation.text: Equipment approval by IT. Owner: IT admin. Shows HR's request (read-only, from Onboarding.ITRequest in the case file) and records the issued equipment in Onboarding.Assets. Accounts are ticked on the IT checklist shown with the task.
Repeating. Further development starts a new round inside this instance; Plan closed ends it, a new instance then waits for the next start.
Starts on Start development plan, or on Further development from the evaluation (a new round).
Exits on Plan performed, which also closes activities still open.
At this level, not inside Evaluate plan, which could auto-complete before it occurs.
Owner: Employee. Starts empty in every round (earlier rounds are archived in PreviousRounds). The manager may also fill it in (delegation).
Owner: Manager.
Owner: Employee.
Required, so the Plan stage cannot auto-complete before approval.

documentation.text: Evaluate & document results. Owner: Manager. Also copies the finished round (plan, approval, activities, reviews, self-assessment, evaluation) into PreviousRounds.

Tells the IT admin that a new equipment request is waiting. The engine only triggers this with Employee.employeeId; the devplan backend resolves the IT admin's address and the employee's name from the employee directory (DB) and sends the mail through the CaseFabric mailcatcher (http://localhost:1080).

Tells HR (and the manager, in cc) that the new joiner is onboarded. The engine only triggers this with Employee.employeeId; the devplan backend resolves HR's and the manager's addresses and the employee's name from the employee directory (DB) and sends the mail through the CaseFabric mailcatcher (http://localhost:1080).
